jobs.title: Platform
jobs.description: Platform – Kinoa Success stories Platform Pricing Insights About About us Press room Careers Contact us Get a demo Contact us Get a demo One platform to run all your app operations at the speed of ideas Get a demo Design sophisticated user journeys Flows Build adaptive, behavior-driven user experiences Map intelligent, multi-step user journeys that respond to what each user does. When someone hits a milestone, makes a purchase, or goes quiet, the right experience kicks in for them, every time. Create in-app experiences, not just messages Dynamic Content Ship rich content without the code changes Deliver rich in-app content that feels native to your app, from offers to full-screen experiences. Build it once as reusable templates, then update and retarget it live, without waiting on a release. In App Messages Reach users in the moment that matters Send banners, modals, and full-screen messages that appear the moment a user does something worth responding to. Built from reusable templates so they feel native to your app, and launched live without waiting on a release. Push Notifications Bring users back at the right moment Send push notifications triggered by a user's behavior or a set schedule, delivered in each user's own timezone. Reach the right segment with the right message, and stay in touch even offline with on-device local notifications. Webhooks Sync with your internal systems Send events from Kinoa to any external service the moment they happen, right from your flows. Use it to trigger new features, send data, or communicate with your internal systems, keeping your whole stack in step. User State Management Understand every user in real time Kinoa keeps a live read on every user, from their behavior and history to their current state, updated the instant anything changes. It's the foundation every segment, journey, and message builds on, so you reach users based on who they are right now, not who they were yesterday. Personalize every user's experience in true real time Live Segments Instant Segments. Instant Personalization. Users move in and out of your segments the instant their behavior changes, with no batch processing and no lag. Build a segment from any signal Kinoa reads, or use a ready-made one to start on day one, then target it across every journey, message, and feature setting. Launch, update, and optimize anything without waiting on development Calendar See everything you have planned, at a glance See all your events and promotions laid out over time, in one view. Know exactly which segments are getting which, and when, so nothing overlaps and nothing slips Resource Management Control all your app assets in one place Import and manage all your app's items, currencies, and bundles in one central library. Reward them through your messages, journeys, and offers from a single definition, so everything stays consistent across your app. Feature Settings Tune your features without a release Change the values behind your features for different segments, in real time, without shipping a new version or waiting on app store review. Turn a feature on or off for specific users, adjust prices or limits, and run different configurations side by side. A/B Testing Test everything Test your in-app messages, push notifications, Flows, and feature settings against each other, splitting users into groups and measuring real results. Pick winners by KPI, not gut feel, so every change you ship is one you can prove. AI-powered integration. Live in hours. Get a demo 1. Lightweight SDK or API 2. AI maps your events and data model automatically 3. Real-time audiences live the moment data flows in 4. Operators launch the first experience, and run everything from there Driving measurable impact “We had the users. We just weren't doing enough with them. Kinoa gave us the ability to reach every user with the right experience at the right moment - personalized messages, dynamic offers, real-time feature changes, all without touching a line of code. The impact was immediate.” Or Reznitsky GM, Testris Block Party, Playstudios “Thanks to Kinoa, the team managed to focus on building the game and it’s content, rather than focusing on monetization strategies. Kinoa allowed us to speed up our roadmap and reach our KPI’s much earlier than we anticipated.” Slava Mudrykh CRO, GammaTime “Kinoa gave our operators direct control over offers, pricing, and feature configuration in every market we publish in. We moved from waiting on releases to acting the moment the data tells us to, and we lifted ARPDAU 43% while cutting development time 32%. That control runs across our portfolio without pulling engineers off the roadmap.” Borja Munt General Manager, Carry1st “The capabilities that we managed to unlock by using Kinoa have created an extensive pipeline of out-of-core events and promotions that we can execute, with a direct impact on our KPI's, from retention, session time, all the way to a direct impact on the revenue of our game. Integration was seamless and worth it.” Glib Platonov CEO, OUTLOU:D Games Scale without limits Built from the ground up for scale, the data infrastructure behind every segmentation query, every event trigger, and every real-time audience update was designed to perform at any volume, from launch day to millions of daily active users. Real-time at any volume Event data flows in and audiences update instantly, whether you're handling thousands of events a day or hundreds of millions. Built for data-heavy apps User fields, event history, session data, and behavioral signals, all processed continuously without lag. Segmentation that doesn't slow down Complex audience queries run in real time, no matter how large your user base. Infrastructure that scales with you No re-architecture, no migration, no scaling ceiling. Still managing your mobile app the old way? There’s a better Get a demo way.
